name: Vorrat
tagline: Know if your household is ready for a crisis, and stay ready.
description: Vorrat (German for "supplies") is a private, self-hosted app for household emergency preparedness. It tracks real stock batch by batch with expiry dates, plans supplies for N people over D days from official civil-protection advice, and runs offline on a small machine such as a Raspberry Pi. The interface follows the Bauhaus idea that form follows the task: ink on paper, a grid of rules instead of boxes, square corners, and three signal colours that each mean one thing. Server-rendered, one stylesheet, one bundled font, WCAG 2.2 AA.

logo.notes: Measured from vorrat/static/icon-*.png (the PWA and apple-touch icons). The three status shapes in a row on Paper (#eeede9) above an Ink band (#141414): a Signal Blue circle, a Signal Yellow triangle with an Ink edge, a Signal Red square. The manifest background_color is Paper and theme_color is Ink. The desktop sidebar sets the icon at 32px with the name "Vorrat" in Jost 600 at 1.375rem beside it. Keep the shapes in this order and these colours, and give the icon clear space of at least a quarter of its width. No vector source exists in the repo, so use the 512px PNG for large sizes.

colors.name: Paper
colors.usage: Page background (--bg). A neutral, very slightly warm grey. Dark: #121212.

colors.name: Card
colors.usage: Header, navigation, inputs and hovered rows (--surface). Sections are not boxed: they sit on Paper under a 2px Ink rule. Dark: #1d1d1c.

colors.name: Ink
colors.usage: Text, headings, rules, control edges, the primary button and the day squares (--ink, also --accent). 15.7:1 on Paper, 18.4:1 on Card. Text on Ink is #ffffff. Dark: #f0efea with #121212 on it.

colors.name: Ink 2
colors.usage: Secondary text and metadata (--ink-2). 7.3:1 on Paper, 8.6:1 on Card. Also the hover fill of the primary button. Dark: #b3b1ab.

colors.name: Line
colors.usage: Hairlines between rows and the empty part of a bar (--line, --track). Never the only edge of a control; fields use Field #6b6a66 (dark #8a8984, 4.8:1 or better). Dark: #343432, track #3a3a38.

colors.name: Signal Blue
colors.usage: Covered: the circle and its word (--ok), and the 3px focus ring (--focus). 7.8:1 on Card. Dark: #86a8ee.

colors.name: Signal Yellow
colors.usage: Soon and low: only as the fill of the triangle, which has a 1.6px Ink edge (--yellow). Never text: 1.8:1 on Card. The same in both themes.

colors.name: Signal Red
colors.usage: Expired, missing, destructive: the square, its word, and the edge and text of the danger button (--crit). 5.9:1 on Card, 5.1:1 on Paper. Dark: #ff7b6e.

display.notes: One variable woff2, subset to Latin and Latin Extended, about 23 KB, SIL Open Font License, bundled in the binary and served from /static/jost.woff2. Never loaded from the internet. Used for page titles, section labels, the big readiness number, counts and the brand name. Page title 1.375rem (1.75rem on desktop) at 600; the readiness number 4rem at 600 with its unit at 1.375rem 400 in Ink 2. Section labels 0.75rem, 600, uppercase, letter-spacing .14em, in Ink.

body.notes: Body text stays in the platform face because it reads best at small sizes on cheap screens. 1rem/1.45. Small text 0.875rem; nothing below 0.75rem. Inputs are 16px so iOS does not zoom. Labels and buttons 600. No lowercase-only Bauhaus type: German capitalises nouns, and mixed case reads faster.

voice.tone: A calm instrument panel, not an app that wants attention. Short, full sentences in active voice, no jargon, no exclamation marks. It informs and never frightens: no sirens, countdowns or red banners. It says what is true and what to do next, in words people read on a bad day, tired and one-handed. Numbers always carry units and "of" ("9 of 56 L", "3 of 14 days"); dates are human ("3 days ago", "12 Mar 2027"). Errors say what to fix, not what broke inside ("Enter a number, like 1.5.").
messagingPillars: Emergency plan first: targets come from official civil-protection advice (BBK) and adapt to household size and days.
Tracks real stock: batch by batch with expiry dates; use-up takes the batch that expires first.
Private by design: one binary, one SQLite file on your own machine. No account, no telemetry, no cloud.
Small and offline: runs on a Raspberry Pi, works without internet and without JavaScript.
Earned engagement: useful every day (expiry, shopping), never streaks, badges or nagging.

use: Ready for N of D days
avoid: jargon such as SKU or inventory unit

imagery.style: Functional, not decorative: user photos of their own products and documents, small inline SVG line icons, the three status shapes, and day squares.
subjects: the household's own product photos (thumbnails from a barcode lookup or a phone upload)
scanned documents such as a passport or insurance
2px-stroke line icons: home, stock grid, plus, shield-check, cart, medical case, people, location pin, gear
status shapes: Signal Blue circle, Signal Yellow triangle with an Ink edge, Signal Red square
imagery.treatment: Product thumbnails are 42px squares (64–88px on forms and item pages), square corners, object-fit cover. Without a photo there is no thumbnail. Icons are inline SVG, 24×24 viewBox, stroke currentColor, stroke-width 2. Status shapes are filled SVG at 0.8em, always followed by a word. The camera scanner is the only black surface: black with a white 3px frame.
avoid: alarm imagery such as sirens or warning tape

layout.radius: 0 everywhere. The circle status shape is the only round form.
layout.borderWeight: 2px Ink rules above sections, under the header and above the tab bar; 2px Ink on buttons and chips; 2px Field on inputs and tick boxes; 1px Line between rows; 3px Signal Blue focus ring.
postureRules: Every screen answers, in order: Are we all right? What needs doing? How do I do it? The most important number is first and biggest.
Readiness is counted in days and drawn as days: one square per planned day (up to 31), filled in Ink for each whole day the weakest essential lasts. Over 31 days, a square-ended bar.

Phone-first, one column at most 720px wide with 16px gutters and a fixed five-place bottom navigation (Home, Stock, Add, Plan, Shopping). Add is a solid Ink cell in the same grid, not a raised button. The current place has a 4px Ink bar above it and bold text. From 64em a 248px sidebar replaces it (Add stock as the one solid button; current item = Paper fill, bold, 4px Ink bar on the left); from 75em pages use .cols at 3:2.
Rules, not boxes: a section is a label, a 2px Ink rule and rows separated by 1px Line hairlines, on Paper. No cards, no shadows.
Every tap target is at least 48px tall (40px for small buttons and chips, rows 56px). One solid button per group; other buttons are transparent with a 2px Ink edge.
Home groups work by what you do with it: Expired (one Thrown away button per row), Use first (one Used up button per row), Running low. The other choice lives on the item page.
Plan lists the essentials least covered first, each with its day squares, its amounts and its status.

Colour means 'look here': the calm state is ink on paper. Status always pairs a shape, a word and a colour: circle = Covered, triangle = Soon/Low, square = Expired/Missing. Bars and day squares are always Ink; the colour sits in the status word beside them.

Components: .btn (transparent, 2px Ink edge, square, 48px, weight 600; .primary Ink fill with Paper text; .danger Signal Red edge and text); field = visible 0.875rem label above a 48px input with a 2px Field border and 16px text; .chip = 40px square, 2px Ink edge, selected Ink fill; .pill = 0.875rem status shape plus word, no fill; .count = the quantity at the end of a stock row in Jost with tabular figures; .notice = Card with a 2px Ink edge, role=status, optional Undo; demo and offline notes are a thin Ink band.

Type scale: readiness number 4rem/600/line-height .95 with its unit in 1.375rem Ink 2; page title 1.375rem (1.75rem desktop); section labels 0.75rem uppercase +.14em in Ink; body 1rem/1.45; small 0.875rem; nothing below 0.75rem.

States: hover thickens link underlines, fills secondary buttons and rows with Card or a light grey, turns the solid button Ink 2. Links are Ink and always underlined. Focus is a 3px Signal Blue outline at 2px offset, never removed. Current item uses aria-current plus a non-colour cue.
No motion: nothing animates, fades or moves on its own. Notices stay until the next page so Undo can't vanish. Honour prefers-reduced-motion and forced-colors by keeping borders.
Secondary information (files, barcodes, prices, history) lives in native <details> disclosures so the first screen shows only daily essentials.

Don't: fonts from the internet, shadows, gradients, rounded corners, animation, fading toasts, red full-screen banners, several solid buttons for one action, inline styles, emoji icons, exclamation marks, yellow text.
